statements.text: One of the things I have heard from my veterans is they are worried about the AI systems potentially going into place, particularly in making the final decisions on benefits. [...] while you are Secretary of the VA can, you commit that there will always be a human who is making the final say on a veteran's eligibility for their claims?
statements.context: House Appropriations hearing on the VA budget request, where a congressman asks the VA Secretary about human oversight of AI in benefits adjudication.

statements.text: I think it is incredibly important for us to be talking about AI as it relates to small business. As you all have pointed out, AI is not something that is coming. AI is here. We see it right now in Louisville, Kentucky.
statements.venue: House Small Business Committee hearing 'How AI Is Shaping the Future of Small Business'

statements.text: This is the kind of thing where, like, AI, I mean, could quite literally cure cancer or potentially be used to develop a type of biological weapon. It is the type of thing where AI can be used to help spur creativity, but we don't want to see it ripping off the beautiful sound of someone's voice or taking the hard work and creative energy that goes into music and products and taking that and taking it away from us.
statements.venue: House Small Business Committee hearing 'How AI Is Shaping the Future of Small Business'

statements.text: How do we replace and how do we protect people whose livelihoods are easily replaced by AI? How do we balance the needs for privacy with the needs for safety and security? [...] How do we make sure that AI is used for good? And this is something that I think is really important work of this body right now.
statements.venue: House Small Business Committee hearing 'How AI Is Shaping the Future of Small Business'

statements.text: I think when we are talking about how do we use AI for good, how do we have this framework, an agency like that really is important for helping us develop those tools.
statements.venue: House Small Business Committee hearing 'How AI Is Shaping the Future of Small Business' (on NIST)

statements.text: I am sick and tired and done with out-of-state corporations coming into our state, our home, our community — and using our resources, wasting and exploiting our people for their gain,
statements.venue: Town hall on AI data centers, Louisville (WDRB)

statements.text: We must not require working families, seniors, and small businesses, all of whom are already stretching every dollar to get by in President Trump's economy, to pay for the costs of bringing this much power online. LG&E must ensure that this hyper-scale data construction and the development of infrastructure required to serve it do not increase costs for existing ratepayers.
statements.venue: Letter to LG&E president on Camp Ground Road data center
